title: Split tools.test.ts into colocated per-tool test files
description: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/tools.test.ts is 3100+ lines covering many tools while newer tests are colocated per-tool (claimNextTask.test.ts pattern). Move each describe block into the matching <tool>.test.ts, creating files where missing. Pure test moves — no assertion changes.
definitionOfDone: tools.test.ts deleted or reduced to shared-fixture helpers only
every moved describe runs under its per-tool file
vitest test count identical before/after (no lost tests)

comments.author: architect-98d69360
comments.content:
SCOPE RE-CUT — read before reviewing this task (architect, 2026-07-31).

This task is now **slice 1 of 4**, not the whole split. The original DoD describes the full job; the daemon exposes no update_task tool for architects, so the re-scope is recorded here instead. QA: judge this task against the slice-1 scope below, NOT against DoD item 1 ("tools.test.ts deleted or reduced to shared-fixture helpers only") — tools.test.ts is deliberately still populated when this slice lands. Slice 4 owns its deletion.

Why: tools.test.ts is 3147 lines / 32 describe blocks, needing ~30 destination files (22 new per-tool files, 6 existing to append into, 1 shared harness, plus tools.test.ts itself). submit_plan hard-rejects past 10 distinct affectedFiles. Unlike the StateManager split, no merge makes this fit — per-tool file count IS the deliverable. Human chose the 4-slice split over raising settings.taskSizing fleet-wide.

Slice 1 scope (10 files):
- NEW src/tools/__fixtures__/toolsHarness.ts — the 120-line beforeEach fixture (setupMoeFolder / createEpic / createTask / createWorker + temp-dir lifecycle), extracted so slices 2-4 import it instead of duplicating it
- NEW getContext.test.ts, checkApproval.test.ts, heartbeat.test.ts
- APPEND startStep.test.ts, completeStep.test.ts, completeTask.test.ts, reportBlocked.test.ts, submitPlan.test.ts
- SHRINK tools.test.ts (8 describes removed, 24 remain)

Siblings, sequenced by order and all blocked on this harness:
- 2.25 task-a1e3148993f7413a900a44dce9429beb — slice 2, task/epic CRUD (9 describes)
- 2.50 task-9cf38eb411b640c5a528866f9dc58a3b — slice 3, QA/claim/governance/archive (9 describes)
- 2.75 slice 4 — chat/activity/cross-cutting, deletes tools.test.ts (6 describes)

Slice 1 must record the pre-split `Tests N passed` count; slice 4's DoD checks the final count against it, which is what proves no test was lost across all four slices.
